decisions.reason: The margin analysis kept its own page through 2024, which signals results that meet aspirations, and it fits the firm's platform strategy in a growing industry with slack to carry it.

Its downgrade from its own page to a mention suggests weaker results, but as a core tariff calculator close to the established offer it is cheap to maintain and likely to be folded into the platform rather than withdrawn.

The area definition tool also lost its own page, hinting at a shortfall, yet it supports location-based tariff and margin products, so a firm with slack in a growing market will likely keep it as a supporting module.
